description: Jeju’s haenyeo culture is marking 10 years since its inscription on UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, with the annual Jeju Haenyeo Festival opening Saturday to commemorate the milestone. The 19th Jeju Haenyeo Festival is being held through Sunday around the Jeju Haenyeo Museum in Gujwa-eup under a theme reflecting on the decade since the UNESCO designation.
